title: Bug 651757: Allow warehouse pick for MTO subassembly after registered put-away
summary: Warehouse pick selection for make-to-order subassemblies now allows higher-level supplied components after production output put-away is registered, completing a fix that enables proper warehouse workflows for MTO items.
key_points: Extended warehouse-picking eligibility to include Planning Level 1 components when output put-away has been registered
Maintained consistent eligibility rules across production-order action, warehouse source reports, and worksheet source selection
Removed incorrect comparison between supplying-line output put-away and component picks that was blocking valid pick scenarios
Added comprehensive test cases covering full output, staged output, worksheet picking, and mixed stock scenarios
Propagated changes to Italian localization layer through Miapp
